title: Mulch & Soil Calculator
description: Work out how many cubic yards or bags of mulch, soil or gravel you need for any bed or area.
howto: Enter the bed length and width in feet.
Enter the depth in inches (3 is standard for mulch).
Read the cubic yards needed and the equivalent bag count.

faqs.a: 2-4 inches is standard for weed control and moisture. Topsoil for planting beds is usually 4-6 inches deep.

faqs.q: How many 2 cu ft bags make a cubic yard?
faqs.a: 13.5 bags. A cubic yard is 27 cubic feet, so 27 ÷ 2 = 13.5.

faqs.q: Does the material type change the math?
faqs.a: No. Cubic yards measure volume, which is the same for mulch, soil, sand or gravel. Only the weight differs.
